title: Final Element After Subarray Deletions
summary: Given an integer array, players Alice and Bob take turns removing subarrays of length less than the current array length.
statement: Given an integer array, players Alice and Bob take turns removing subarrays of length less than the current array length. Alice aims to maximize the final element, and Bob aims to minimize it. Both play optimally, and the game ends when only one element remains. Return the final element.
constraints: Alice and Bob alternate removing a nonempty proper contiguous subarray, Alice first.
Alice maximizes and Bob minimizes the sole final value.
Return the final value under optimal play.
hints: Only an original endpoint can be made final without exposing a worse reply.
Alice may delete everything except either endpoint in one move.
The minimax structure bounds the result by that larger endpoint, and Alice’s immediate deletion attains it.
editorial: The minimax structure bounds the result by that larger endpoint, and Alice’s immediate deletion attains it.

tests.explanation: Alice can leave endpoint two immediately, and cannot force the interior five, so the value is two.
Alice chooses the larger endpoint seven.
